summary_md: **Arthur Fiorette ([@arthurfiorette](https://x.com/arthurfiorette/status/2116005543324115288))** built **tests-diet**, a skill and CLI that ran a pool of 32 Haiku agents on Pi with read-only tools to triage 33,817 unit tests across 4,335 files for about $23, cutting 7 minutes from each CI run; it resumes if stopped and reports which tests to delete or merge, plus a writing-tests skill to prevent bloat ([arthurfiorette/tests-diet](https://github.com/arthurfiorette/tests-diet), [Pi](https://pi.dev)).
